context.content:
> Honestly I doubt the problem is related to the thickness because the left one is thinner and didn't have the problem.

The thickest edge is irrelevant, that can be different due to a difference in Rx. I am talking about the center thickness and am only talking about tenths of a mm. 

> and the coating is the same.

But if the center thickness is too thin *and* the coatings are bad it will contribute to this type of failure on the too thin lens and not the thick enough lens. 

Anyway IMO the most likely culprit is the lens is too large, with the other factors being possible minor contributors to push the problem to the point of breakage.
